a pratidvandvi–ity adarśanaṃ saṃyoga-nimittam uktam / Na–atra
darśanaṃ mokṣa-kāraṇam, adarśana-abhāvād eva bandha-abhāvaḥ sa mokṣa iti / Darśanasya
bhāve bandha-kāraṇasya–adarśanasya nāśa ity ato darśana-jñānaṃ kaivalya-kāraṇam uktam
/ Kiṃ ca–idam adarśanaṃ nāma ? Kiṃ guṇānām adhikāra āhosvid dṛśi-rūpasya svāmino
darśita-viṣayasya pradhāna-cittasya–anutpādaḥ svasmin dṛśye vidyamāne
1218 darśana-abhāvaḥ
kim arthavattā guṇānām atha–avidyā sva-cittena saha niruddhā
1219 sva-cittasya–utpatti-bījam
/ Kiṃ sthiti-saṃskāra-kṣaye gati-saṃskāra-abhivyaktiḥ / Yatra–idam uktam-- pradhānaṃ
sthityā–eva vartamānaṃ vikāra-akaraṇād apradhānaṃ syāt, tathā gatyā–
